issue_context.title: defaultpreemption: refactor out support for out-of-tree plugins
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added**: defaultpreemption plugin has some exported functions that are designed to be reused by out-of-tree plugins. Refactor these out of default_preemption.go. Also, refactor the functions themselves to be cleaner, they're kinda ugly right now.

**Why is this needed**: default_preemption.go is very confusing right now.

/sig scheduling
/kind cleanup
/cc @Huang-Wei @ahg-g @alculquicondor
comments: @adtac do you want to incorporate this into #94814, or in a separate PR?

I think we could just simplify things in #94814 to not assume that the functions it modifies are stateless (and so no need for the With pattern etc.), then in a followup PR we move those to a type named `PreemptionEvaluator`.

SGTM, so far no consumer is vendoring the 1.20 codebase, so we have enough time finishing the refactoring in a followup.

@adtac apologize for the comments back and forth.
np, update the PR -- FindCandidates now uses state from `DefaultPreemption`. I'll refactor that out in a followup.
@adtac A data point FYI on how out-of-tree plugin uses the utilities in `DefaultPreemption`: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/scheduler-plugins/tree/master/pkg/crossnodepreemption
@Huang-Wei ack. IIRC scheduler-plugins's release cycle is synced with k/k? So if this is the first out-of-tree plugin making use of defaultpreemption methods, we should be fine, yes?

thanks @alculquicondor , pls let me think about this.
@alculquicondor I have sent out the proposal, I tend to go with your idea and make the change accordingly if there is no further comments.

review_comments:
The architecture we want to achieve is something like we did for https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/master/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/noderesources

That is, plugins would create some sort of "preemption scorer" object for which you can configure some functions.
I'm not quite liking the dependency of this package on the framework types.
I would create a separate package for preemption somewhere in pkg/scheduler/framework, but outside of plugins.
